repositories.name: vllm
repositories.message:
Integrate Kimi memory reuse and decode scheduling options (#925)

Bound vision intermediates, gather variable-length image embeddings, reuse consumed activations and residual storage, and add optional projection sharding, L2 prefetch and KDA projection overlap. CPU regression and local lint checks are recorded; full GPU graph, aliasing, model-evaluation and performance qualification remain incomplete and are accepted for integration.

Signed-off-by: Martin Vit <martin@voipmonitor.org>

repositories.name: vllm_jovian
repositories.message:
Fix deferred grammar rejection in v2 speculative sampling

Propagate grammar-invalid draft suffix lengths to the v2 worker and sharded
sampler. Restore invalid input IDs in the existing grammar-mask kernel before
rejection sampling, respecting device logit bounds for shortened verification
windows. This prevents accepted draft counts from exceeding grammar-valid
counts after termination without adding a GPU launch.

Keep the scheduler assertion and include request and draft counts on failure.

Validation: 49 focused grammar, scheduler, and GPU tests passed; all applicable
pre-commit hooks passed.
The focused Qwen3.8 checkpoint-tokenizer/native GPU probe reports one accepted
draft for one valid draft. The original serving request and throughput have
not been replayed.

Signed-off-by: Luke Alonso <lalonso@gmail.com>

repositories.name: b12x
repositories.message:
Support prepared PCIe collectives for uneven TP/DCP groups (#411)

Add partial-island hierarchical all-reduce for 9/10 ranks and prepared DCP attention exchange for 9/10/12 ranks. Retain compiled launcher dependencies, preserve paired-gather defaults, and cap partial-island default dispatch at 32 KiB. CPU topology and preparation validation: 154 passed. DCP suite: 39 passed and 27 pre-existing failures reproduced on the landing base. Final-source multi-GPU and serving qualification remain pending.

repositories.name: sparkring
repositories.message:
Record MiMo image input working on the MiMo vision fix image

Installations of mimo-v26-flash-rl-tp2 and mimo-v26-flash-rl-tp4 through
install.sh on image dev-20260927-mimovision-cuda1342-nccl2323-status032,
checked by the profile acceptance harness, passed all 7 functional checks:
asked for the colors of a red-and-blue picture, MiMo answered red and blue on
both clusters, where the parent image answered black and white. The
256-request screens returned no degenerate response; the wrong answers are
question a4 each time, as on the parent image. Decode at 1 / 8 / 16 streams,
temperature 1.0: 36.1 / 138 / 212 tokens/s on the pair and 52.9 / 188 / 342
on the ring, with verification step rates within 5% of the parent image's.

The README's MiMo rows, their measurement links and both MiMo profiles'
evidence text cite these records. Host names and network mount names in the
installer logs are replaced with NODE_A-NODE_D and NETWORK_SHARE_n.

Validation: markdown link, release-safety and Compose example checks pass.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
